# claude-os

> A documented, production-tested framework for running Claude and a coordinated multi-AI stack as an operating system: session protocols that load context before every task, an Obsidian vault as the memory layer, and workflow frameworks for content, music, and code.

Docs only, no runtime. For the companion Cloudflare Worker (grok-mcp-server) see [aunysillyme-dev/grok-mcp-server](https://github.com/aunysillyme-dev/grok-mcp-server).
